titles.romaji: Baka to Test to Shoukanjuu: SPINOUT! Sore ga Bokura no Nichijou
titles.english: Baka and Test – Summon the Beasts 2 Specials
titles.native: バカとテストと召喚獣SPINOUT! それが僕らの日常。遠征中

description:
Spin-off of Baka to Test to Shoukanjuu that has been serialized on Famitsu Comic Clear website since 2010.

These specials are included in the Baka to Test Ni! BD/DVD releases.
